title: Enterprise Connectivity: portfolio reduction fraction
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following portfolio reduction fraction for each named contract tier. Discount fraction when the portfolio threshold is met; decimal.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | portfolio reduction fraction | 0.025 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | portfolio reduction fraction | 0.03 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | portfolio reduction fraction | 0.035 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | portfolio reduction fraction | 0.04 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | portfolio reduction fraction | 0.045 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | portfolio reduction fraction | 0.05 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the portfolio reduction fraction is 0.025.
